data.title: Bundesliga Matchday Preview: Bayern Munich vs. Borussia Dortmund - Yahoo Sports
data.content:
The Schwarzgelben shares the same record as Bayern in the league: five wins and two draws after seven games with Bayern ahead of them on goal difference. This match will allow the winner to lay down an early marker for the title race.

Location: Allianz Arena, Munich, Bavaria, Germany
